descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT EFS state 3; TFA-94745 AC 3; UAT 3.5 · “Anything the physician dictated or typed is never lost in any failure state”. Mixed: stated part — Points and draft kept and an explicit error shown when the summary call fails; our part — The hang-past-timeout variant and the case-only pair staying two points (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B20 · fixed on 8b4be94a · was S1 · no longer counted

Save Note rewrites Important Points: even when the AI call fails (a point differing only in case is dropped, an unsaved draft becomes a card); Nursing Home rebuilds their ids on every save

Tickets: TFA-92590 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: fixed: Save Note never touches Important Points, including failure and retry (TC-12/S19 local + 10 live dev cycles, S28).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-12/S19

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S28 Save Note's AI call fails or hangs: the points and the unsaved draft are kept exactly (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 If Save Note's AI call fails or is slow, nothing the physician typed is lost: the points stay exactly as they were (ids, text, order), an unsaved points draft is kept, and a clear message shows (the … (UAT 3.5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT TC-10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; … (TFA-92590 AC 4; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each seeded with three points (including a case-only pair) and an unsaved points draft

When Make the pre-round parse action (ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, and the Nursing Home parse) (a) throw on the first call, (b) hang past the timeout; type a note and tap Save Note; then retry (or let the fallback run) until it succeeds

Then After the failure, and again after the retry succeeds: the stored list is identical to the seed (ids, text, order; the case-only pair still two points); the draft is kept while it failed; an explicit error is shown, never a silent wait

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; never left waiting), Empty & Failure States ('Pre-round summary failed: raw dictation kept, error shown'; 'Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost'), TFA-92590 AC 2 / AC 4. Judged on a backend read after the failure: importantPoints == seed (ids, text, order) and importantPointsDraft == the seeded draft; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the bug was fixed on 8b4be94a and this re-test passes, so its status is kept (the rows below are about the older build).

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 ready for qa

When Save Note's AI call fails or hangs, the Important Points have already been rewritten. In Hospital a point that differs only in case is dropped and the unsaved draft becomes a card; Nursing Home re-creates the cards from the editor box.

Evidence: allure 38c5588d: the error does show (after 1.4 s, or about 68 s on a 65 s hang), but the stored list has already changed and stays changed after the retry. TC-12 matrix knownGaps record the Hospital case-insensitive de-dup (uniquePoints, TFA-92590 AC 4 / Q6) and the NH rebuild from the box. TC-12 risks list the rewrite-before-the-AI-call order. The draft becoming a card is TC-12 Q4 (Daniela).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.
